fullpage-shot capture fixtures

Serve this directory with python3 -m http.server 8777 and capture each page. Every band is exactly 100 px tall and labelled with its index, so a duplicated, missing, or torn band is visible at a glance.

  • sticky.html — sticky header, sticky footer, and a sticky section with an absolutely positioned child. Each must appear exactly once. Expected height 3152 px.
  • fixed-in-transform.html — a position: fixed element inside a transformed ancestor. It scrolls with the page and must not be hidden. Expected height 3000 px.
  • scroll-snap.html — scroll-snap-type: y mandatory. Must leave no gaps. Expected height 3000 px.
  • lazy-grow.html — grows during the pre-pass, from 1500 px to 4000 px of bands.
  • inner-scroller.html — a scrolling pane inside a static shell. Must be refused with a message, not silently mangled.
  • overlay.html — full-screen cookie scrim. Exercises the keep/strip overlay option. Expected height 2500 px.
  • entropy.html — near-incompressible noise, to push a frame toward the 64 MiB messaging ceiling.
